title: Derive an observer-consistent Hubble-flow proxy before catalogue testing
faithful_claim: The Saulder differential-expansion test constrains an imposed deformation of Millennium mocks. Wiltshire objects that its mass-radius calibration and line-fraction interpolation omit timescape curvature and lapse. Establish a model-to-observable contract before using that proxy as a timescape test.

assumptions: Retain timescape wall/void averaged geometry and the lapse; flat LambdaCDM Millennium is a comparison/mock ancestry rather than retained timescape physics.
Line fraction, curved proper volume and distance/redshift relations are distinct. A matching endpoint or small mean distance difference does not validate joint catalogue statistics.
Coherent infall, distance/mass estimation, morphology selection, sky mask and mock-volume reuse can affect the same statistic.

minimal_test.question: Can a proposed approximation jointly map mass/geometry/clocks into finite-infinity line fractions and relativeHubble observables while satisfying the source dressed-expansion identity?
observables: A located symbolic or independently specified mapping for the joint pair(H_rel,f_fi), with the mass-volume-radius and observer-distance relations stated.
Endpoint/clock/flat-curvature limits and consistency of mass-volume calibration with the same geometry used for sightline distances.
Only after closure: selected-sample weighted and binned slopes plus full covariance and mock dependence, in declaredLG/CMB frames with identical selection.

parameter_choices.reason: Source proxy values are historical comparison targets, not a validated timescape simulation or accepted initial conditions.

minimal_test.scope: First deliver a falsifiable derivation/consistency audit. Do not launch a catalogue simulation or fit until the theoretical/observational mapping and nuisance calibration are fixed independently of the statistic to be tested.

simplifications: This source-development contract supplies no self-consistent general timescape N-body or light-cone simulation.
No transfer of Millennium peculiar velocities, Euclidean radius-volume law or linear line-fraction rule is certified as timescape physics.
No joint analysis with supernovae, CMB, BAO or AvERA/LTB as interchangeable models.
data_dependencies: For a later observation test: SDSSDR12/2MRS groups, fundamental-plane calibration and updated finite-infinity catalogues inAppendixA/CDS/VizieR, whose external full tables were not inspected.
Eight underlying Millennium mock regions create64 ordered pairs but36 unique combinations; reuse does not yield64 independent cosmological realizations.

Proxy andLambdaCDM mocks share matter distribution, mock calibration and selection ancestry; richness mismatch, missing mass,15-20% radius/mass/distance uncertainty and incomplete sky coverage remain.
unknowns: Object-level timescape curved-volume/radius/clock/light-cone mapping and its theoretical uniqueness.
Self-consistent peculiar-motion/structure-evolution closure and initial conditions at catalogue resolution.
Full released catalogue bytes/selection, fundamental-plane systematic covariance, common-object normalization and mock dependence.
1811 Table1 printed slope-scatter versus standardized-discrepancy inconsistency; raw statistic/output necessary for repair.
verification_gates: Derive wall-clock dressedH identity and preserve dimensional/clock conventions throughout observable construction.

Distinguish volume fraction from line fraction and specify proper/geodesic/areal radius before any curved-volume comparison. A negative-curvature sphere exceedsEuclidean volume at fixed proper radial radius, not an arbitrary radius convention.
Check correct limit cases and permit failure of proposed proxy; no assertion that all possible nonlinear approximations are excluded.
Freeze model mapping and prior choices before observationalfit; a tunable mapping chosen from the tested trend is not a prior prediction.
Before significance claims verifyTable1 raw statistics; keepTable2 reported1.52/2.08sigma conditional, overlapping-bin covariance and reused mock volumes explicit.
Require an accepted consumer development path; noLCDM/CPL relabeling or arbitraryJSON equation execution.
falsification: Failure to satisfy the lapse identity, declared geometry-volume law or joint observable mapping rejects a proposed timescape approximation. A closed and independently fixed mapping later inconsistent with calibrated joint(H_rel,f_fi) data could reject that specified timescape variant. The current proxy mismatch and reply alone neither falsify nor confirm the full model.
